samples.evidence: [/page/1/Text/6] A modified psychological autopsy approach was used to explore 20 case studies of student suicide from the period 2000–2005, drawing on the perspectives of family members, friends and university staff. [/page/4/Text/6] 20 cases of student suicide occurring between May 2000 and June 2005 were studied. [/page/5/Text/5] Most of the case studies (18 of 20) involved young men in their early twenties.
